text: 2c.1-B1 TAMAM: EventMainManager iskeleti canli kanitlarla yazildi (commit 9454d5d98). Canli SPK_EventMainManager.obj 3 katman olarak cozuldu: (1) SPK GUI editor ailesi (DialogProc/LoadDetails/Save x CC/DS/Invasion/CTCMini/SkyEvent/Item380/ItemDrop/ItemMove/ItemOption/ItemStack/MocNap — runtime kapsam disi), (2) config sema anahtarlari (WarningTime/NotifyTime/Year/DoW/Level/ExperienceTable/MoneyTable/GateNpcLife/StatueNpcLife/Enable/PKCanJoin/EnableQuest/KillCount/BlowUserRate/ExpRank — BC/CC/DS yukleyicileri bu obj'de; semalar bizim MEM-script .dat ile BIREBIR), (3) SkyEvent runtime (map<int,vector<SKYEVENT_MONSTER_DATA>> + SKYEVENT_REWARD_DATA). SkyEvent semalari canlidan okundu: Event\SkyEvent\Config.xml (Stage/Time/Win: ExtraExpStage + Item + WcoinC/WcoinP/GPoint) + Monster.ini (stage bolumu + Class X Y Dir). Yeni modul: SPK/EventMainManager.h+cpp — LoadSkyEvent (pugixml+MemScript), Load() merkez yukleyici, 5-durum state machine (EventGvG deseni) + CheckSync (jokerli schedule), kancalar ReadEventInfo + gObjEventRunProc + vcxproj. Deploy: 5 canli .ini + SkyEvent kopyalandi (config icerikleri bizimle birebir; .dat→.ini yol-gecisi ayri kalem). Derleme temiz → 10.809.344 B (20:55, +6656); obj/exe/PDB kanitlari tam (SKYEVENT_MONSTER_DATA x16, canli yollar exe'de x1). Sirada: 2c.1-B tekil event'ler veya A2 MonsterSkill.
